lhs: Integrate[x^(nu + 1)*Hypergeometric1F1[2*a - nu, a + 1, -x^2/2]*BesselJ[nu, x*y], {x, 0, Infinity}]
rhs: 2^(nu - a + 1/2)*Gamma[a + 1]/(Sqrt[Pi]*Gamma[2*a - nu])*y^(2*a - nu - 1)*E^(-y^2/4)*BesselK[a - nu - 1/2, y^2/4]

lhs: Integrate[x^a*Hypergeometric1F1[a, (1 + a + nu)/2, -x^2/2]*BesselJ[nu, x*y], {x, 0, Infinity}]
rhs: y^(a - 1)*Hypergeometric1F1[a, (1 + a + nu)/2, -y^2/2]

lhs: Integrate[x^(nu + 1 - 2*a)*Hypergeometric1F1[a, 1 + nu - a, -x^2/2]*BesselJ[nu, x*y], {x, 0, Infinity}]
rhs: Sqrt[Pi]*Gamma[1 + nu - a]/Gamma[a]*2^(-2*a + nu + 1/2)*y^(2*a - nu - 1)*E^(-y^2/4)*BesselI[a - 1/2, y^2/4]

section: 7.66 Combinations of confluent hypergeometric functions, Bessel functions, and powers
tex: int_0^inf x 1F1(lam;1;-x^2) J_0(xy) dx = [2^(2lam-1) Gamma(lam)]^-1 y^(2lam-2) e^(-y^2/4)

lhs: Integrate[x^(nu + 1)*Hypergeometric1F1[a, b, -lam*x^2]*BesselJ[nu, x*y], {x, 0, Infinity}]
rhs: 2^(1 - a)*Gamma[b]/(Gamma[a]*lam^(a/2 + nu/2))*y^(a - 2)*E^(-y^2/(8*lam))*WhittakerW[(a - 2*b + nu + 2)/2, (a - nu - 1)/2, y^2/(4*lam)]
section: 7.66 Combinations of confluent hypergeometric functions, Bessel functions, and powers
tex: int_0^inf x^(nu+1) 1F1(a;b;-lam x^2) J_nu(xy) dx = 2^(1-a) Gamma(b)/(Gamma(a) lam^(a/2+nu/2)) y^(a-2) e^(-y^2/(8lam)) W_{k,mu}(y^2/(4lam)), 2k = a-2b+nu+2, 2mu = a-nu-1
note: k = (a-2b+nu+2)/2, mu = (a-nu-1)/2 substituted

lhs: Integrate[x^(2*b - nu - 1)*Hypergeometric1F1[a, b, -lam*x^2]*BesselJ[nu, x*y], {x, 0, Infinity}]
rhs: 2^(2*b - 2*a - nu - 1)*Gamma[b]/Gamma[a - b + nu + 1]*lam^(-a)*y^(2*a - 2*b + nu)*Hypergeometric1F1[a, 1 + a - b + nu, -y^2/(4*lam)]
section: 7.66 Combinations of confluent hypergeometric functions, Bessel functions, and powers
tex: int_0^inf x^(2b-nu-1) 1F1(a;b;-lam x^2) J_nu(xy) dx = 2^(2b-2a-nu-1) Gamma(b)/Gamma(a-b+nu+1) lam^(-a) y^(2a-2b+nu) 1F1(a;1+a-b+nu;-y^2/(4lam))
